fields.label: Job Category
fields.note: filterDef.allFilters[job_category] multi_select_facet_search; option values are the lower-case labels the API echoes back (e.g. 'software', 'supply chain & operations').

notes: HP's board is Phenom PCSX at https://apply.hp.com/api/pcsx/search. Required parameters: domain=hp.com, start (offset), sort_by. Keyword goes in 'query'; a city string goes in 'location'. Facet filters use the pattern filter_<filterName> where filterName comes from the response's own filterDef (confirmed: filter_seniority, filter_job_category, filter_locations). The response echoes the accepted selection in data.appliedFilters, so a param that is not recognised can be detected (filter_include_remote was silently dropped, so no workplace-type field is declared). Sorts are relevance and timestamp.
